headline: Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah announced a Rs5.3 billion relief package for drought-affected communities in 25 dehs of Tharparkar and Umerkot, with each eligible family to get Rs8,000 in three instalments through the BISP payment mechanism, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Har mutasira khandan ko Rs8,000 teen qiston mein milenge

caption:
Thar aur Umerkot ke khushk saali se mutasira dehaat ke liye Rs5.3 arab ka relief package! 🇵🇰
Dawn ke mutabiq Sindh ke Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah ne Tharparkar aur Umerkot ke 25 dehs ke liye Rs5.3 billion ke relief package ka elaan kiya hai. Har mustahiq khandan ko Rs8,000 teen qiston mein milenge, jo Benazir Income Support Programme ke zariye diye jayenge, taake aata, maveshiyon ka chara aur doosri zaroori cheezein khareedi ja sakein. Pehli qist 1 December tak, doosri 1 January tak aur teesri 1 February tak di jayegi. Isi taqreeb mein gandum ke kisanon ke liye bhi 25 acre tak zameen par Rs4,000 fi acre DAP subsidy ka program shuru kiya gaya.
Kya yeh madad khushk saali se mutasira logon ke liye kaafi hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
